articles.text: ZHŌNGGUO XUÉSHENG: Wǒde tiān na! Nǐ hái zài niàn shū? Ēi, hē bēi píjiǔ xiūxi xiūxi hǎo bu hǎo?
CHINESE STUDENT: My God! Are you still studying? Hey, how about taking a break for a beer?
MĚIGUO XUÉSHENG: Hǎo hǎo hǎo, ràng wo bǎ zhèiyìdiǎnr kànwán xíng bu xíng?
AMERICAN STUDENT: Okay, okay, let me finish reading this little bit, okay?
ZHŌNGGUO XUÉSHENG: Hài, nǐ zǒngshi kàn gǔshū! Xiànzài shèhuìde qíngxing, nǐ jiù yìdiǎnr dōu bù kǎolǜ ma?
CHINESE STUDENT: Come on, you're always reading classics! Don't you ever think about the condition of today's society?
MĚIGUO XUÉSHENG: Shéi shuō wǒ bù kǎolǜ? Xuéshēnghuìde shì wǒ yě zuòle bù shǎo ma!
AMERICAN STUDENT: Who says I don't think about it? I've done a lot with the Student Association, you know!
ZHŌNGGUO XUÉSHENG: Nǐ zhēn yǒu yìsi! Zuò yìdiǎnr xuéshēnghuìde shì jiù shi guānxīn shèhuì le!
CHINESE STUDENT: You're something else! Just doing a little work with the Student Association means you're concerned about society!
MĚIGUO XUÉSHENG: Nà nǐ shuō, wǒ yīnggāi zuò diǎn shénme ne?
AMERICAN STUDENT: Well then, what do you think I should do?
ZHŌNGGUO XUÉSHENG: Dàlùshang yǒu nàme duō rén, nǐ zěnme bú wènwen tāmende qíngxing zěnmeyàng?
CHINESE STUDENT: There are so many people on the mainland; how come you don't try to find out what their situation is like?
MĚIGUO XUÉSHENG: Wǒ juéde zhèngzhì wèntí tài máfan, wǒ bù xiǎng tán zhèngzhì.
AMERICAN STUDENT: I think that political problems are too much bother. I don't like to talk about politics.

ZHŌNGGUO XUÉSHENG: Wǒ yě méiyou yào gēn ni tán zhèngzhìde yìsi. Wǒde yìsi shi, nǐ yánjiū Zhōngguode shíhou, yìfāngmiàn yào kànkan gǔshū, yánjiūyanjiū Zhōngguo chuántǒng wénhuà, yìfāngmiàn yě kěyi kànkan zhèi yìbǎiniánde Zhōngguo lìshǐ.

CHINESE STUDENT: I didn't mean I wanted to talk politics with you. I mean that as you study China, on the one hand you should read the classics and study traditional Chinese culture, but on the other hand you can also read some Chinese history of the past hundred years.
MĚIGUO XUÉSHENG: Zhèi yìdiǎn shi duìde. Zhèi yìxuéqī wǒ bú shi yǒu Zhōngguo jìndàishǐ kè ma?
AMERICAN STUDENT: You're right about that. I have modern Chinese history class this semester, don't I?
ZHŌNGGUO XUÉSHENG: Wǒ xiǎng chúle shàng xué yǐwài, nǐ hái kěyi kàn yìdiǎnr xiǎoshuōr.
CHINESE STUDENT: But I think that besides taking classes, you could read some fiction, too.
MĚIGUO XUÉSHENG: Kàn xiǎoshuōr?! Wǒ nǎr yǒu shíjiān kàn shénme xiǎoshuōr?
AMERICAN STUDENT: Read fiction?! When do I have time to read any fiction?
ZHŌNGGUO XUÉSHENG: Wǒ zuìjìn zài kàn jǐběnr Zhōngguo jìndài xiǎoshuōr, fēicháng yǒu yìsi. Nǐ rúguǒ xiǎng dǒngde Zhōngguo xiàndài shèhuì, zhēn děi duō kàn diǎnr zhèizhǒng xiǎoshuōr.

CHINESE STUDENT: Lately I've been reading a few modern Chinese novels which are very interesting. If you want to understand modern Chinese society, you really have to read more of this kind of fiction.
MĚIGUO XUÉSHENG: Wǒ zěnme kěyi hé nǐ bǐ, nǐ kànde nàme kuài! Ē, zhèiyàng hǎo bu hǎo: nǐ kànwán yǐhòu gàosu wo nèiyìběn hǎo yìdiǎnr, wǒ zài kàn, xíng bu xíng?
AMERICAN STUDENT: How can I compare with you; you read so fast! Hey, how about this: after you've finished reading them, tell me which book is best and then I'll read it, okay?
ZHŌNGGUO XUÉSHENG: Hǎo hǎo hǎo, jiù zhèiyàng ba! Xiànzài wǒ bú zài máfan nǐ le. Ēi, duì le, jīntian wǎnshang zánmen chī shénme? Wǒ lái zuò yìdiǎnr, hǎo bu hǎo?
CHINESE STUDENT: Okay, that's what we'll do. Now I'll leave you alone. Oh yeah — what are we going to eat tonight? I'll make something, okay?
MĚIGUO XUÉSHENG: Bú bì zuò le, suíbiàn chī diǎnr ba! Wǒ niànwán zhèiyìdiǎnr, zánmen chūqu chī pǐchá bǐng, hǎo bu hǎo?
AMERICAN STUDENT: You don't have to make anything. Why don't we just have something easy. After I finish reading this, how about going out and having a pizza?
ZHŌNGGUO XUÉSHENG: Hǎo! Nǐ kuài diǎnr niàn, niànwán zánmen jiù zǒu.
CHINESE STUDENT: Okay! Hurry up and read; we'll leave right after you finish.
